snippet.title: FARMER REBORN OFFICIAL GAMEPLAY TRAILER | 2025 🚜
snippet.description:
🌾 FARMER REBORN – Gameplay Trailer 🌾
Step onto the fields of your dreams and build the farm you always imagined. In Farmer Reborn, you’ll plant crops, raise animals, design your land, and bring a whole new world of farming magic to life.
📅 Release Date: December 12, 2025
💸 Free to play from day one!

Get ready to sow, grow, and harvest – and join a community of passionate farmers who are returning to their roots. Don’t forget to subscribe and hit the bell to catch all updates and behind-the-scenes content.

#FarmerReborn #FarmingSimulation #FreeToPlay
